perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier subfield < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The delivered results establish the three separated asymptotic branches and feasible branchwise inference, but they do not provide one data-driven procedure valid near either transition, so the advertised software use requires an externally supplied regime classification. Feasible nuisance replacement and calibration are proved only for the one-dimensional smooth-boundary Bernoulli subclass, while the broader marked regular-variation class receives oracle results only. The efficiency theorem concerns regularity along a constructed ambient dominated experiment whose paths are not shown to remain in the model class, so it is not a class-intrinsic or minimax efficiency frontier. The final Honest scope is stale and internally contradictory because it labels Theorem 3 and several proved ingredients unestablished despite the preceding theorem and proof text. The absence of an implemented application or numerical calibration study, together with non-specific sourcing of the classical leaf lemmas, limits the completed package's leading-journal score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: related_work_incomplete@thm:feasible-separated-coverage
